Proposition
[Ricci-flat holonomy (Proposition 35.10)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0306 1. ch35:35.10\group Linear Stability

A simply-connected irreducible compact Ricci-flat manifold either has holonomy $\mathrm{SO}(n)$ or admits a nonzero parallel spinor.
